summary: Join our Carbon Management and Emissions Reduction Training Course to gain essential knowledge and tools for effective climate action and sustainable practices.
lede: Carbon management training helps sustainability, operations, finance and supply-chain professionals identify and manage emissions from organizational activity. It covers distinguishing Scopes 1, 2 and 3, preparing an emissions inventory, and assessing reduction options such as energy efficiency, renewable energy and offsets. Participants also consider costs, operational trade-offs and how to explain climate decisions to stakeholders using measured outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across various sectors, responsible for spearheading environmental initiatives within their organizations.
modules: Foundations of Carbon Management and Climate Responsibility
Identifying Reduction Strategies and Low-Carbon Initiatives
Economic and Operational Evaluation of Sustainability Investments
Carbon Offsetting vs. Direct Reduction Strategies
Climate Policy, Disclosure Standards, and Corporate Responsibility
Risk and Opportunity in Decarbonization Strategy
Integrating Carbon Management into Business Operations
Communicating and Defending Climate Decisions Internally and Externally
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites, but a basic understanding of environmental sustainability concepts is recommended.
